purpose: Central relationship index for crawlable AzerothMarket content entities.
implementation_rules: Every published entity must have a stable id and status.
Every confirmed factual relationship must carry source_ids.
Do not publish an empty or speculative Boss/Loot/Blueprint record as confirmed content.
Unknown values remain null, empty, or pending rather than being inferred.
Entity pages should link outward to related entities so the database becomes a navigable graph.
Zones, quests, NPCs, and currencies may be indexed before dedicated page templates exist; their canonical destination should remain stable.
Beta-era changes must be tracked against dated official sources and must not silently overwrite earlier confirmed facts.
Live-service observations from beta are provisional until corroborated or documented by an authoritative source.
